prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: high quality background painting for an existing 2D space shooter browser game, landscape 1536x1024.
Primary request: A premium cinematic deep-space environment with an enormous realistically illuminated dark blue planet or moon in the upper right, occupying about 35% of the composition, a delicate cyan crescent on its rim, rich but restrained wisps of turquoise and cobalt nebula, distant pinprick stars and fine cosmic dust.
Style/medium: richly detailed hand-painted science fiction concept art with convincing cinematic depth and atmospheric light, subtle realistic surface texture and layered space clouds, professional game environment asset.
Composition/framing: Wide landscape. Planet is concentrated in the upper-right quadrant and cropped slightly by the top/right edge. The center and bottom two thirds are predominantly very dark, calm navy negative space for bright gameplay ships and bullets. Wisps wrap around the outer perimeter, with a small warm violet gas accent near the far upper-left periphery. Keep the playfield readable and uncluttered.
Lighting/mood: Dark, immersive, mysterious, polished, monumental sense of scale; luminous turquoise edge light and faint scattered stars. No glaring white light clusters in the center or lower two thirds.
Color palette: deep midnight navy, dark cobalt, teal, restrained cyan, tiny muted violet accents.
Text: none.
Constraints: Must be an actual environmental background image, not a game screenshot. No spacecraft, characters, foreground objects, text, HUD, grid, logos, watermarks, flat vectors, bright white nebula clumps, or black featureless silhouette planet. Visible subtly lit planet surface texture.
description: Cinematic midnight-blue game background with a textured cyan-rimmed planet in the upper right and quiet central/lower playfield.
